name: holdout_detector_disjoint_v1
description: Detector-disjoint holdout subset — 7 cases whose inconsistent claims were discovered by external sources (PubPeer/correction notices) and whose anomaly types (label_swap / misaligned_records / mislabeled_panel / provenance_mismatch / assignment_inconsistency / pseudoreplication / undocumented_derivation) are NOT covered by the duplicate-column / fixed-offset / paired-ratio / cross-sheet-reuse detector family. Use to test whether B3 FAR generalises beyond the detector's training distribution.
